original_question: Are there constructions of (n + 1)-polytopes from n-polytopes whose resulting symmetry type graphs differ from the families produced in Theorem 4.2 and from their duals?
target_in_paper: The open problem in Section 4 immediately following Theorem 4.2, asking for new rank-raising constructions that yield 2-orbit symmetry types beyond the families obtained in Theorem 4.2 and beyond those obtained from them by duality.
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the local target in the paper: it is about constructions of higher-rank polytopes from lower-rank ones, and it specifically excludes the symmetry type graph families already produced by Theorem 4.2 and their dual counterparts. It also correctly focuses on symmetry type graphs rather than on a broader geometric or group-theoretic problem.
missing_details: The paper is working in the setting of abstract polytopes, not arbitrary geometric polytopes.
The question is specifically about producing new 2-orbit symmetry types (via symmetry type graphs), not just any new (n+1)-polytopes.
The output should be phrased as an existential question about constructions/operations, not as a classification problem.
The comparison is with the exact families listed in Theorem 4.2 of the paper, together with the families obtained from those by duality.
It helps to say explicitly that a symmetry type graph is the quotient of the flag graph by flag-orbits under the automorphism group, since that is the invariant being compared.

Your draft does not say explicitly whether the source n-polytope is assumed to lie in the same 2-orbit framework being discussed in the surrounding section; the paper’s context is the 2-orbit setting.
The phrase "their duals" should be made explicit as dual symmetry types / symmetry type graphs arising from dual polytopes, so the exclusion is clearly up to duality.
refined_question: In the setting of abstract 2-orbit polytopes, do there exist constructions that take an abstract n-polytope to an abstract (n+1)-polytope and produce a 2-orbit symmetry type graph (that is, the quotient of the flag graph by automorphism-group flag-orbits) which is not one of the symmetry type families listed in Theorem 4.2 of the paper and is not obtained from one of those families by duality?
justification: The draft is already aimed at the correct place in the paper: Section 4 discusses constructions that raise rank and records, in Theorem 4.2, the resulting families of symmetry type graphs. The nearby open problem asks whether there are further such constructions yielding new 2-orbit symmetry types beyond those families and their duals. The refinement above keeps exactly that scope, makes the 2-orbit/symmetry-type setting explicit, and does not broaden the question to arbitrary k-orbit polytopes or to unrelated realization problems.
